meta.title: Work Chain
meta.description: Keep the current session as leader; pick each member's provider/model from dropdowns populated by the DSH provider catalog (default deepseek-v4.1-flash), and member names default to the model name (duplicates get -2/-3). Run the fan-out and collect results through the built-in team task board. Also ships a leader-only Aesthetic Advisor (aesthetic_advice) that reviews UI/visual quality and only gives advice — it never edits files.
